integrity: The proof is analytic and symbolic; no numerical certificate is required. The source's warning that spherical monodromy determines length only modulo 2\pi is respected, and the exact value is obtained independently from the midpoint geometry before local constancy is invoked.
scientific_limitations: The exact-length conclusion is for the connected open primitive periodic component containing the midpoint orbit; no classification of all trajectories or of indefinite members is claimed.
title: Exact half-great-circle length in the odd regular spherical projective-billiard family
